tooltips.boosterContentNotes:
Notes:
  • Zero is a valid value (useful for Pauper or Artisan for example).
  • A land slot will be automatically added for some sets.
  • Unused when drawing from a custom card list: See the advanced card list syntax to mimic it.
tooltips.cardsPerPickDesc: Number of cards to pick from each booster. Useful for Commander Legends for example (2 cards per booster).
tooltips.firstPickOnly: First Pick Only: The custom value will only be used for the first pick of each booster, then revert to 1. For example, you should check this with a value of 2 for Double Masters sets.
tooltips.burnedCardsDesc: In addition to picking a card, you will also remove this number of cards from the same booster. This is typically used in conjunction with a higher count of boosters per player for drafting with 2 to 4 players. Burn or Glimpse Draft is generally 9 boosters per player with 2 cards being burned in addition to a pick.

tooltips.cardsPerBoosterCustom: Cards per Booster when using a Custom Card List, ignored when using custom sheets; Default is 15.
